decisions.rationale: Distinguish the tested states exactly as the recheck specifies. The untouched starter is checked on its shipped Standard route and separately against increment 1. For Fast route N, verification uses uncommitted private checkpoint bytes with increments 1..N-1 complete: on that state only N fails before work, and all 1..N pass after completion. Remove the claim that the shipped starter fails only the newest increment on every route. Private checkpoint bytes are verification aids that never enter the repository (same boundary as reference solutions).

Add a minimal minuted FT12 orientation right before the first commands: what npm ci and npm test do, the expected failing-test shape, a quick check that the learner can name the failing outcome, and pointers to the later npm (FT13) and Vitest (FT15) topics. Rebalance inside the 70-minute increment without removing outcomes.
